claim: a Vec+sort+dedup region build was measured and rejected, not shipped
why_measured: hot_regions was the dominant measured cost at 20TPS (88-97 percent for actor fixtures, 44-47 percent for furnace fixtures)
result: 1.10-1.29x faster for sparse centers, 0.72x for densely clustered centers. Whole-process CPU 0.2766s -> 0.3469s.
decision: reverted. Clustered centers are the realistic load because players gather at bases and spawns, so a 40 percent regression there outweighs the sparse-case win.
mechanism: sorting costs O(candidates) while hash dedup costs O(distinct chunks). Dense centers make candidates far exceed the distinct set.
bug_found: the candidate dropped forceloaded chunks from hot. The independent-oracle membership test caught the missing (200,-200).
provenance_note: results.json was captured on the candidate sources. HEAD differs in: ['src/main.rs']. Reverted, so HEAD is the pre-candidate code.
next: only attempt again with a strategy branch chosen by candidate-count versus set-size ratio, and only if it wins on every fixture shape.
